harness_auth.measured: Claude Code 2.1.299 (Linux, 2026-10-17; claude --version reads '2.1.299 (Claude Code)'): strings -n 8 of the installed binary holds one array literal of its provider credential variables, the seven ANTHROPIC_*, AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN names here, defined beside its CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH switches and its provider endpoint table. The twelve AWS, GCP and Azure credential-chain names are read by the provider SDKs, not by that list: they are declared on the operator's ruling of 2026-10-18 (U9b1's ruling 5), so MB4's collision check refuses a binding of them, and no cloud route was exercised to measure them
